FN-JPXLHYF-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 253
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Ritchie Whorton
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/10/2026
REVISED
House Bill 253as introduced would increase the annual additional fee for the issuance of
distinctive vehicle license plates, from $1 under current law to $10, to firefighters, volunteer
firefighters and professional firefighters. This bill would also provide for the distribution of
these funds as shown below, which would increase estimated receipts to the entities listed by the
amounts shown:

New Fee $10
